replaces: fondo-v1 (archived with its history; its equity tilts rest on the earnings-yield anchor that was not supported)
principle: Money moves only on the mandate or on components with a supported registered out-of-sample verdict; everything else stays at a diversified market default.

derivation.sources: equity share chosen by the owner inside the 60-90% mandate; 60/40 US/international is the convention of broad index target-date funds; AGG is the US aggregate bond market

rebalancing.rule: trade back to the strategic weights only when any sleeve deviates more than 5 percentage points in absolute terms

distributions: reinvested in the simulation through adjusted closes; in a broker account they arrive as cash and count toward drift

enable_only_after_supported_registered_t: equity valuation anchor at long horizons
engine_tilts.each_enablement: new policy version with its own track record

exception_rules.missing_or_stale_price: no trade that day; the review records the missing input
exception_rules.data_older_than_3_sessions: no trade; the panel warns that the fund is not current
exception_rules.drawdown_beyond_historical_worst: no discretionary selling; the rebalancing rule continues and the panel flags a review

user_adjustments: the web page offers sliders to compute a personal variant; the published fund always follows these registered weights

report: months to recover the previous peak
T3_long_history.acceptance: descriptive: the owner accepts the reported ranges before any start

T4_etf_era.costs: 5 bp spread plus 2 bp slippage on traded value
acceptance: annualized tracking error against the same weights rebalanced monthly <= 1.5%

T5_operational_replay.period: last 30 published cuts available in the repository archive
acceptance: no order on a day without a deviation above 5 pp
identical output on a second run
